name: project-paced
description: Draft, preview, save and maintain project timelines with Project Paced.

interface.longDescription: Turn a project brief into a timeline you can preview, save and edit. Connect your Project Paced account to open existing projects, organize milestones by date and category, add dependencies, and update progress. Preview a proposed plan before saving it, confirm milestone deletions and timeline replacements, and open your project on the Project Paced website.
defaultPrompt: Draft a six-week launch plan and show me its timeline before saving.
Open my project and help me update the next milestone.
Turn my project brief into phases, dates and dependencies.

positive.prompt: Plan a six-week website launch. Show me a timeline before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Gather dates and constraints, preview the draft, save only after approval. Direct saving uses no Project Paced AI allowance.

positive.description: Open and update an existing plan
positive.prompt: Open my launch plan and move the design phase to 12 October.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the intended project, use its current revision, change only the requested milestone, then reload authoritative state.

positive.prompt: Add a launch review on 20 November to my project.
positive.expected_behavior: Add one milestone, preserve the rest, and show the updated timeline.

positive.prompt: Use Project Paced AI to create a delivery timeline from my brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the remaining integration allowance and use one generation. If replacing a plan, confirm the replacement first.
Ask for explicit confirmation. After confirmation delete only the selected milestone, then reload.

negative.prompt: My integration AI allowance is exhausted. Generate another timeline with Project Paced AI.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Project Paced AI is unavailable. Offer to draft a plan in the conversation and preview/save supplied milestones within the project limit.

negative.prompt: Edit my second, locked project without upgrading.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain read-only access. Do not overwrite the editable project or bypass the paid gate.

negative.prompt: Overwrite newer changes without reloading, or modify another account’s project.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the stale or unauthorised write. Reload permitted data and ask how to reconcile; never retry blindly with a newer revision.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1 removes subscription and allowance language from the listing description. Includes timeline previews, direct plan saving, milestone editing and explicit confirmation for destructive actions.
